'''Nitoo''' was a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a merchant aboard [[Carrick Station]] during the conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

Nitoo wore [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Boot/Legends|boots]], a green, white, black, and brown [[Clothing/Legends|outfit]], a [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]], and a piece of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] on his left shoulder.<ref name="TOR" />
